vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: gws-gmail-reply
Version: 1.0.9

The skill bundle provides documentation and instructions for an AI agent to use a 'gws' CLI tool to reply to Gmail messages. The files (SKILL.md and _meta.json) describe standard email functionality, including threading and attachments, and do not contain any evidence of malicious intent, data exfiltration, or prompt injection attacks.

llm.summary: The skill is internally consistent with a CLI wrapper that calls an existing 'gws' binary to reply to Gmail, but it delegates auth and global flags to an external shared SKILL.md that you should inspect before installing.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (Gmail reply) match the declared requirement of a single binary 'gws' and the SKILL.md usage examples — asking for a gws CLI is coherent for a Gmail-related wrapper.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions are limited to invoking the gws CLI and describe only mail-reply flags. However the SKILL.md explicitly delegates auth, global flags, and security rules to ../gws-shared/SKILL.md; that external file may request credentials or additional behavior, so review it before use.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec and no code files — this is instruction-only. That minimizes on-disk footprint; the only runtime dependency is the preinstalled 'gws' binary.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: This skill declares no required env vars or credentials itself, which is reasonable. But because it points to a shared auth SKILL.md for credentials, required environment variables or OAuth tokens may exist elsewhere — those are not visible here and should be checked for proportionality to Gmail access.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill is user-invocable; it does not request any permanent agent-wide privileges in the provided files.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a thin wrapper that runs the local 'gws' CLI to send Gmail replies. Before installing or using it: 1) Inspect ../gws-shared/SKILL.md (or run 'gws generate-skills' as suggested) to see how authentication is performed and what credentials or scopes are required; 2) Verify the 'gws' binary on your system is from a trusted source and understand how it stores/uses OAuth tokens or environment variables; 3) Ensure no unrelated credentials are referenced in the shared auth file; 4) If you cannot audit gws-shared, proceed cautiously — the skill will act with whatever Gmail access the gws CLI has, including sending mail or accessing your inbox.
